title: Polynomial-time computability of the reduction map
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $V$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $d,c,C_V,c_V$ be natural numbers. The map that sends a finite Boolean string $x$ to the encoding of the quantified Boolean formula constructed from $N,d,c,V,C_V,c_V$ and $x$ is computable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
A finite deterministic Turing machine $V$ over Boolean symbols
caveat: The construction of the reduction map depends on numerous circuit, tableau, and formula encodings supplied only as Lean definitions; its exact informal construction cannot be fully recovered from this payload.
